before.lib/job.ex:
defmodule Job do
  @moduledoc "Internal in-memory metadata; status is an arbitrary atom."
  defstruct [:status, :detail]
end

after.lib/job.ex:
defmodule Job do
  @moduledoc "Internal in-memory metadata; status is an arbitrary atom."
  defstruct [:status, :detail]
end
after.test/job_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule JobTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "supports each job state" do
    for status <- [:ready, :running, :done, :failed] do
      job = %Job{status: status, detail: to_string(status)}
      assert job.status == status
      assert job.detail == to_string(status)
    end
  end
end
